test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: By selling an article for ₹170, a man loses 15%. What per cent will he gain or lose, if he sells it form ₹206.40?
solution:
Given:

SP of an article = ₹170

Loss = 15%

Formula used:

CP = [SP × 100/(100 – loss%)]

where,

CP = cost price

SP = selling price

%Profit = (Profit/CP
